**Date:** [12 December 1896]  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95

[To [Miss Hall](people/person_2396.qmd)]

There is no Diocesan Leaflet to Winchester See

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** A postcard postmarked Winchester 2.15 PM De 12 96, addressed to ‘Miss Hall/ Greyladies/ Blackheath Hill/ London SE’. The College of Greyladies was a community of women engaged from about 1893 in social work, ‘in the sober fashion of the Church of England’ as its founder the Bishop of Southwark put it in a letter to *The Times* (2 February 1895).  Susan Esther Wordsworth was subsequently its head.
